title: Lean Manager (Remote/Travel Required)
description:
CORPORATE OVERVIEW
Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri with more than 1,200 employees and nearing $2B in revenue, Alberici is a diversified construction company that partners with leading organizations throughout North America to build their most challenging and important projects.
Since our founding in 1918, Alberici earned a reputation for executing with quality, safety and trust. Combined with our 100+ years of experience, we provide construction solutions to the automotive, commercial, civil, energy, food & beverage, healthcare, heavy industrial, industrial process, and water industries.
We build the critical structures that improve lives and strengthen communities.
Our mission is simple - and our approach to delivering on it is equally straightforward. We are as open and honest with our employees and partners as we are with our clients. We are here to work together to do the best work possible to bring this mission to life.
When it comes to our team, Alberici employees are built differently. We seek the best and brightest and are committed to investing in our people and providing the training and resources they need to learn, grow, and advance.
Our Values:

• Working Safely

• Valuing Diversity

• Serving Humbly

• Executing with Integrity

• Solving Creatively

• Engaging Fully

What We Offer:

• Profit-sharing plan, cash bonus programs and annual cost-of-living adjustments

• Generous salary increases and per diems for qualified out-of-town assignments

• Health, dental and vision insurance eligibility on day one

• Paid parental leave

• Continuing education reimbursement

• Personalized career development and training programs

• Minimum of 29 days of PTO (including holidays) for entry-level roles

• Fitness center for St. Louis office-based team members

• Gym membership reimbursement for project-based team members

• Corporate office cafeteria access

• Employee Resource Group (ERG) opportunities

• Philanthropy opportunities

POSITION SUMMARY
The Lean Services Manager will train, implement and provide oversight for the Alberici Lean Edge (ALE) program for projects, Champions Academy, ACT, and Field/Trade Leadership programs. This position collaborates closely with project teams to provide Lean training to improve project outcomes. They also share responsibility for the identification of Lean initiatives, and the expansion of the Lean mindset of continuous improvement.
Essential Responsibilities & Duties include the following; however, other duties may be assigned. The Company provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with a disability, unless doing so poses an undue hardship on the Company. To be a qualified individual, an employee must be able to perform each of the essential functions of his or her job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

• Serves as a change agent that implements best practices and models behaviors that strengthen the Lean culture emphasizing continuous improvement to achieve superior project outcomes.

• Trains, mentors, and collaborates with teams on the core practices within ALE: Team Building and Alignment, Conditions of Satisfaction, Big Room, Last Planner System, Facilitation, Coaching and Training, 5S, and Gemba.

• Leads partnering sessions and Team Health assessments for large and diverse groups.

• Trains and mentors teams on the Last Planner System of Production Control, operating in a digital environment, emphasizing reliable commitments to achieve an optimum flow of work.

• Trains project teams to facilitate phase pull plans, weekly coordination meetings, and daily huddles.

• Trains project teams to deploy the Site Organization System (5S) fully.

• Mentors assigned project teams by using the Explain, Demonstrate, Guide, and Enable (EDGE) model.

• Meets regularly with Champions and project teams to review their Lean Journey progress and provide mentoring to further their progress.

• Utilizes data and analytics to support project teams.

title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Observability & Evals Platform
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The LangSmith team owns and builds LangChain's core platform for observability, evaluation, and production reliability of AI systems. From tracing and annotation to run rules, evaluations, and beyond, this team owns LangSmith end-to-end. If you want to define what great AI observability looks like at production scale, this is where that work gets done.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team building LangSmith, our observability and evaluation platform for LLM applications. You’ll define the technical direction, grow and mentor a world-class engineering team, and partner with product and design to deliver features that help developers build and deploy trustworthy AI systems with confidence.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers, fostering collaboration, ownership, and accountability

- Strengthen LangChain’s engineering culture through mentorship, high-quality code, and technical excellence

- Shape long-term technical direction and ensure scalability and reliability of LangSmith AI Observability Platform

- Partner with product and design teams to define scope, sequence, and success criteria for key initiatives

- Maintain a high bar for technical excellence while making sure the team moves with urgency and focus

- Lead by example in writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code in Go/Python and Typescript

- Engage directly with customers to understand their needs and translate them into actionable product improvements

 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Experience managing or tech-leading teams delivering complex full-stack products

- Strong technical background in Go/Python and React/Typescript

- Solid understanding of databases (Postgres, Redis and ClickHouse)

- Proven ability to design high throughput data-intensive systems

- Bias towards shipping quickly and learning from customers

- Strong communication skills-able to collaborate with internal stakeholders and engage directly with customers

- Bonus: Experience building AI/LLM-powered applications, developer tools, or observability platforms

 

- Annual salary range: $200,000- $240,000

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

BENEFITS

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US

title: Werbetexter für Newsletter & Mailings (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen jemanden, der bei uns Newsletter schreibt und sie gleich fertig baut.
Kurz zu uns: Wir sind Rügamer & Steiner aus Düsseldorf, über 35 Leute, und wir machen E-Mail-Marketing für mehr als 150 Online-Shops. In Zahlen: 8 E-Mails pro Sekunde, 250 Millionen Empfänger im Jahr. Jede einzelne Zeile davon hat jemand von uns geschrieben & designt.
Wenn du gerade Texte abgibst und danach nie wieder siehst, was daraus geworden ist: Hier ist es ungefähr das Gegenteil.
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgaben liegen morgens bereit. Ein Shop braucht einen Sale-Newsletter, der nächste stellt eine neue Kategorie vor. Du liest dich ins Briefing ein, überlegst dir den Aufbau, schreibst Betreffzeile und Text, ziehst dir die Blöcke aus unserem Figma-Designsystem und passt die Grafiken an, teilweise mit KI. Dann geht der Newsletter zur Freigabe an den Kunden und raus.
Du betreust 30 bis 40 Marken. Nach ein paar Wochen weißt du, wie jede einzelne klingt.
Qualifikation

Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft: Bei uns wird Vollgas gegeben, 100 % vor Ort mit dem Team in Düsseldorf.
Auge für Ästhetik: Du hast ein Auge dafür, was gut aussieht, und traust dich an ein Design-Tool.
Extrem schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Neue Tools lernst du in Tagen.
Ehrgeiz und Eigenantrieb: Du nimmst Feedback an und wirst mit jeder Woche besser.
Du gehst selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools um.
Du schreibst gut und schnell. Texte, die verkaufen, nicht Texte, die nur schön klingen.
Du willst das ganze Ding verantworten , nicht nur deinen Teil davon.

Figma, Newsletter oder Designausbildung? Kein Muss.
Auge, Tempo und Einstellung entscheiden. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.
Benefits

Kein internes Ping-Pong. Du gibst deinen Text nicht

title: American Tech Fellowship for Veterans
description:
A World-Changing Company
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, power decisions on the battlefield, locate missing children, and more.

Applications for the Fall 2026 cohort are now open.

The Program
In the 20th century, America pioneered mass production. We built the Arsenal of Democracy, won WWII & the Cold War, and then left the Arsenal to rust. Silicon Valley, a product of the Heartland, turned its back on the American worker.
It’s time to reawaken the giant.
The same spirit of practical innovation that enabled America to dominate the previous century lives on in every American factory, workshop, and garage today. The proliferation of Artificial Intelligence poses risks, but also the opportunity for a technological and industrial renaissance.
Palantir launched the American Tech Fellowship to arm Americans with the skills to deploy cutting-edge software in the workforce. Fellows will have an opportunity to explore and build on Palantir’s Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) and earn a professional certification in its use. Exceptional performers will earn an opportunity to interview for a role at Palantir or partner companies, where they can use their newfound skills to contribute to the reindustrialization and revival of America.
This fellowship is about more than careers-it's about restoring the promise that hard work and determination can still change your life in America. It's an investment in American excellence, evidence of our belief that America's greatest builders are still to be discovered.
The American worker, given the right tools and opportunity, remains our competitive advantage. It’s time to prove it.
The Role
In this fellowship, you'll participate in a comprehensive virtual training program with our partner, Ontologize, to level up your technical skills on Foundry and AIP. You'll learn how to deploy Palantir's cutting-edge software to solve tough problems in enterprise settings and have the opportunity to engage directly with Palantir engineers and leadership.
The fellowship will run for 12 weeks. Participants are expected to attend live virtual sessions on two weeknights each week. We will also have optional sessions once a week and office hours throughout the duration of the program. Participants can anticipate dedicating a total of 5 to 10 hours per week to instruction and project work throughout the fellowship. Exceptional performers will have opportunities to interview for full-time employment opportunities at Palantir and our partner companies.

This program provides valuable training to participants and is unpaid.
What We’re Looking For

We want builders-people who are hungry to learn whatever it takes to win in the new AI era and aren’t afraid to wire a sensor, flash firmware, or ship production code to make it happen. We’re looking for the technically inclined across all Military Occupational Specialties who can wield Palantir’s tools to solve real-world problems. Whether you’re on Active Duty, in the Reserves, the National Guard, or someone who has left military service, we need you to forge the future of American AI.

Some signals that you’re that kind of person might be if you’ve taught yourself-or been the local go-to-for at least one of these stacks:

• General-purpose code: Python, C/C++, C# / .NET, Rust, Go, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript

• Data / scientific: SQL, MATLAB, Simulink, R, Julia, Excel + VBA

• Embedded & controls: Arduino/MicroPython, ROS, LabVIEW, Ladder Logic / Structured Text, G-code, PLC or SCADA configuration

• Hardware description: Verilog, VHDL, SystemVerilog, FPGAs

• You’re comfortable in-or eager to master-the Linux shell, Git, and container tooling like Docker or WSL.

title: Enterprise Account Executive-South Bay
description:
The Role

You'll own a mostly greenfield enterprise territory and have a core focus on generating new logos

New business usually starts with a team already running ClickHouse - open source, or a Cloud account someone expensed - until a bill or a security review pushes the conversation up to the platform team and the budget owner. Common triggers: an Elasticsearch or Splunk bill that's hard to defend, a warehouse that can't serve a customer-facing feature fast enough, an AI product querying tens of billions of rows.

What You Will Be Doing

- Own the full sales cycle for both new and existing accounts in your territory - first conversation through security review, procurement, and close, on Cloud commitments and multi-year committed spend.

- Grow your install base by landing new teams and new use cases inside accounts that already buy from us.

- Own renewals and consumption commitments, working with your Solutions Architect and Support to get ahead of usage and churn risk.

- Watch consumption trends across your accounts and engage early when usage flattens or spikes. Both are signals.

- Find and convert existing ClickHouse usage in new accounts. Unmanaged open-source deployments and self-serve Cloud accounts are the highest-yield source of new pipeline in this segment.

- Multi-thread across the data platform team, the budget owner, security, and the executive sponsor rather than relying on a single champion.

- Work with your Solutions Architect through the technical evaluation. They own the technical win, you own the commercial strategy and the close.

- Run the procurement path: security questionnaires, legal redlines, vendor onboarding, and BYOC or private-deployment requirements.

- Give your champion the internal business case - TCO comparison against the incumbent, migration plan, and risk mitigation.

- Map the remaining teams and use cases in each account and build an expansion plan against them.

- Keep Salesforce accurate and submit a forecast leadership can plan against, across both new business and expansion.

- Participate in the developer community in your territory: meetups, conferences, and events.

What You Bring

- 6+ years selling technical infrastructure to enterprise buyers - databases, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, observability, or developer tooling.

- A track record closing complex deals that went through security review, legal, and procurement.

- Enough technical fluency to hold an architecture conversation. You don't need to write SQL, but you should be able to explain why a company moves a workload off Elasticsearch.

- Experience carrying a hybrid quota - new business alongside expansion and renewal - and the discipline to work both rather than defaulting to whichever is easier that quarter.

- Experience with consumption-based or usage-metered commercial models, where revenue moves with usage between contract events.

- Experience selling into developer-led, bottom-up adoption as well as top-down.

- Ability to orchestrate people who don't report to you - Solutions Architects, executive sponsors, partners, product managers.

- Accurate forecasting, including when the number is bad.

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clic

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer - AWS & Salesforce (UK)
description:
Project Overview: At Flosum , we build the leading native DevOps, Release Management, and Data Backup solutions for the Salesforce ecosystem. While our core platform is native to Salesforce, we utilize a hyperscale, open-cloud architecture on AWS for key web applications and high-throughput background processing.
We are looking for an expert Senior QA Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain an end-to-end automated testing framework that bridges our AWS cloud web applications and our core Salesforce architecture. This is a mission-critical role where you will ensure the seamless, secure sync of enterprise DevOps data between cloud microservices and Salesforce metadata.
What You Will Do:

• Design and implement an automated testing framework covering both our AWS-hosted web app and our connected Salesforce native workflows.

• Automate end-to-end user journeys that cross platforms (e.g., actions initiated in our cloud web UI that trigger deployments or metadata backups inside Salesforce).

• Create stable UI tests for Salesforce Lightning that resist dynamic ID changes and effectively handle Shadow DOM components (using UTAM, Playwright, or enterprise testing tools).

• Develop robust API automation suites to validate real-time data integrations, webhooks, and secure queues running between AWS and Salesforce.

• Integrate the automated test suites cleanly into modern Git-based CI/CD pipelines.

Requirements
Required Experience & Skills:

•
4+ years in QA Automation Engineering, specifically handling complex enterprise integrations.

•
Deep Salesforce Expertise: Exceptional understanding of Salesforce Lightning architecture, metadata, security models, and developer workflows.

•
Technical Stack: Proficient in code-first automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) OR deep expertise in Salesforce-specific automated testing systems (Provar, ACCELQ, or UTAM framework).

•
API & Database Testing: Expertise in REST API testing and a strong command of SOQL queries for direct Salesforce database verification.

•
DevOps Mindset: Solid experience setting up automated test steps within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, or cloud developer tools).

title: Freelance Sales Rep (Commission-Only), Hospitality Software
description:
Mangobeds is a property management system for colivings, hostels, hotels, campsites, glamping sites, cabins, retreats, surf stays, villas and vacation rentals, from small independents to large operators running 10 to 200 units. We have paying customers across Europe, the Americas and Asia, and we are looking for self-employed sales reps to bring us more.

THE DEAL
- Commission-only. You earn 30% of everything a customer you bring pays us in their first 12 months, rising to 35% and then 40% as you close more.
- Paid monthly, within 15 days of month end, once the customer has been with us for one month. No long vesting, no quarterly wait.

- You find the properties yourself. You choose the markets and the operators you go after, and we back you with full product access, demos and pricing support whenever you need them.

- Fully remote, your own hours, no quotas, no daily activity reports.

YOU WOULD BE A GOOD FIT IF
- You have sold software, travel or hospitality services before and can run your own pipeline end to end.
- You know the coliving, hostel, hotel or holiday rental world, or you will learn it fast. Experience selling to larger operators and multi-property groups counts for most here.
- You are self-employed and can invoice us.
- You speak English, plus any of Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, French or German.

ONE HOUSE RULE
If another rep is already working an account, you cannot jump on it. Ask us and we will tell you who has what.

WHAT YOU GET FROM US
- Full access to the product, a demo property, recorded walkthroughs and a deck.
- A Mangobeds email address and direct access to the founder for demos and pricing questions.

description:
About us    

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving. 

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us-we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.  

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

About the role

We are looking for an ML Software Engineer to join the Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA) team within Wayve Science as a founding member.

MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots: models that learn from large-scale video, language, and robot-interaction data, then generalize across tasks and embodiments-including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms, and humanoids. Our aim is to build agents that can perceive, reason about, and act reliably in the physical world.

You will design and build the software systems that enable MEGA's machine learning research. This includes scalable ML pipelines, data and training infrastructure, and the shared tools and abstractions that allow researchers to move quickly from an idea to a reliable experiment.

The role sits close to the models and data. You will work with large-scale video and robotics datasets, modern ML frameworks, and increasingly large models, building systems that remain reliable and maintainable as the research program grows. A major part of the role will be designing and maintaining robust workflows and reusable infrastructure that can support multiple ML projects. This emphasis on infrastructure, software systems, repo health, testing and maintainability is central to the role.

You will be a core member of the MEGA team, owning key parts of the software and ML infrastructure that underpin the research program. You will work directly on the systems used to build, train, evaluate, and scale our models, and help shape how the team develops and operates its ML stack as the program grows.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain scalable ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, evaluation, and related research workflows.

• Build software systems that allow ML workloads to scale to larger datasets, larger models, and more experiments.

• Develop clean and reusable interfaces between data, models, training, evaluation, and downstream robotics workflows.

• Own and improve the health of the MEGA codebase, including software architecture, testing, reliability, maintainability, and engineering standards.

• Identify and resolve performance, reliability, and usability bottlenecks across ML workflows.

• Build and maintain infrastructure that supports multiple researchers and ML projects without unnecessarily slowing down iteration.

• Work closely with researchers to understand the requirements of new models and experiments, and translate those requirements into practical software solutions.

• Build and use distributed training and data-processing pipelines for large models and large multimodal datasets.

In order to set you up for success as an ML Software Engineer at Wayve, we're looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

• Strong software engineering skills and experience building high-quality, maintainable software.

title: Senior Cryptography Engineer
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel:  
Job ID: 1893 

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities :

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

• Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS

• Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

• Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills

• Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

title: Senior Specialist, Benefits & HRIS

Supporting approximately 1,000 employees across multiple states, this role handles the hands-on execution that keeps benefits accurate and compliant in every jurisdiction we operate in, and keeps our HR data clean, secure, and reportable.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work with meaningful independence on established programs and processes, escalating plan design decisions, budget commitments, and novel compliance questions to the Manager or Director. It suits someone who takes real satisfaction in getting the details right - reconciling a carrier file, catching an eligibility error before it becomes a claim problem, and explaining a deductible clearly to an employee who is worried about a bill. This person works independently, knows when to escalate, and maintains accuracy and composure during high-volume periods.

• Serve as first-line support for employee benefits questions, claims issues, and eligibility inquiries; escalate complex disputes and exception requests.

• Maintain vendor relationships at the service level - open and track tickets, hold carriers to service standards, and flag performance concerns to the Manager.

HRIS Administration & Reporting

• Serve as primary day-to-day administrator for UKG: process transactions, maintain configuration within established design, manage security role assignments, and test releases.

• Maintain data integrity through recurring audits, validation checks, and reconciliation across HRIS, payroll, benefits carriers, and the 401(k) recordkeeper.

• Monitor integrations and EDI feeds to downstream systems; triage failures, resolve routine errors, and escalate structural issues to the Manager and vendor support.

• Audit that leave status changes entered by HR Business Partners flow correctly through to benefits eligibility and carrier feeds, and flag gaps before they result in a coverage lapse.

• Build and maintain standard and ad hoc reports and dashboards - headcount, turnover, benefits enrollment and cost, and EEO and compliance reporting.

• Contribute to system projects and module rollouts as a functional resource: document current-state processes, write test scripts, execute testing, and support training and go-live.

• Create and maintain process documentation and job aids; train HR partners, managers, and employees on self-service functionality.

• 4+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, or a similar role, ideally in technology.

• Experience building partnerships that are closely connected to a product or customer experience.

• Experience working closely with Product and Engineering to turn partner needs into scalable solutions.

• Unshakable optimism in the face of adversity.

• We give people ownership and trust them to make good decisions.

• We move quickly, learn from customers, and improve continuously.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (Physical AI & Autonomy)
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

THE ROLE

This is a senior, high-trust role owning the product narrative for Alfie, RobCo's flagship Physical AI product line - the fastest-moving, highest-margin part of our business and the centerpiece of our category leadership story. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing - with a named Product counterpart and a standing seat at roadmap and design reviews.

You'll also carry a rare kind of stakes: Alfie debuts publicly at RobCoN in March 2027 - the biggest product launch in RobCo's history. Getting there is a multi-month campaign spanning film, digital, and physical activation, and you will own video production for Alfie end-to-end across it. This is the kind of launch most product marketers wait a career for.

We care more about how well you understand the technology - and the people selling it - than about your marketing pedigree. If you've spent years elbow-deep in robotics, automation, or industrial engineering, and you have a real talent for explaining complex things clearly - to a sales rep, a customer, or a skeptical engineer - we want to hear from you. A background in Product Marketing is a plus, not a prerequisite.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Own the Alfie & Physical AI Narrative

- Develop the core messaging and positioning for Alfie - value props, differentiators, use cases - and own the framework that Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and External Comms all draw from.

- Translate complex robotics and AI concepts into language that lands with the audience in front of you, whether that's a plant manager, a procurement lead, or a skeptical engineer.

2. Content & Sales Enablement

- Own the Alfie whitepaper, technical datasheets, solution briefs, and use case fact sheets - written to be used, not filed away.

- Build and own the Alfie sales enablement deck, competitive battlecards, and demo scripts - and drive adoption to 100% among Alfie-selling AEs, not just ship-and-hope.

- Run enablement sessions so commercial teams can articulate Alfie's value confidently and consistently.

3. A Real Seat at the Product Table

- Named Product/Engineering counterpart and a recurring, calendar-mandated syncs.

- Standing invite to Alfie roadmap - access by default.

- Close the loop: bring field and customer insight back into Product, and get roadmap context out to Sales before it's old news.

5. RobCoN Launch & Content Production

- Own video production for Alfie end-to-end - from the recurring proof-point films that build the campaign through to the flagship film that plays live on the RobCoN stage.

- Drive Alfie's presence across the full run-up to RobCoN - our biggest product launch to date - partnering closely with Product and external creative partners to ship against a fixed, public-facing calendar.

- Own the RobCoN messaging framework and speaker briefing materials, and help shape how the live stage moments land.

- This is a high-visibility, high-stakes mandate: the work you ship here will be seen by the entire company, our customers, and the market, at the most important moment in RobCo's history so far.

We're Looking for Someone Who Has

- 6+ years of relevant experience - this can be Product Marketing, but just as easily Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering, Applications Engineering, Technical Consulting, Product Management, or a hands-on role in robotics, automation, or industrial tech. We're hiring for depth of technical understanding first.

- Real fluency in robotics, automation, mechatronics, industrial hardware/software systems, or AI - gained on the job, not just in a classroom.

- A track record of turning technical complexity into content

About The Role:

Kong is building Project Volcano, an internal developer platform purpose-built for Kong's engineering ecosystem. Volcano will provide teams with on-demand preview environments, edge deployments, managed PostgreSQL, auth, realtime, and storage APIs all deeply integrated with Kong products.

As the Senior SRE for Volcano, you will be the reliability voice for this platform. This role is a strategic initiative driven by the Office of the CTO (OCTO). You will partner directly with engineering leadership to define the platform's reliability posture. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with direct influence on Kong's next generation developer platform.

 

What You'll Do:

- Own reliability for Volcano end-to-end: Define and drive SLOs, error budgets, and incident response practices for all Volcano services - edge deployments, managed Postgres, auth, realtime, storage, and the control plane.

- Contribute to the platform's infrastructure: Design and build the multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure, networking, and data plane that powers Volcano's edge deployment pipeline and backend-as-a-service capabilities.

- Build the GitOps and CI/CD backbone: Establish deployment automation, canary pipelines, and preview environment provisioning using ArgoCD, Helm, and Terraform/Terragrunt - setting patterns the broader team will follow.

- Scale managed data services: Design, operate, and harden multi-tenant PostgreSQL clusters, Redis caching layers, and object storage - with a focus on data isolation, performance, and disaster recovery.

- Drive observability from day one: Instrument every Volcano service with meaningful SLIs; build dashboards, alerts, and runbooks using Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana before services go live, not after incidents.

- Lead cross-functional reliability work: Collaborate with the OCTO team, product engineering, and security to bake reliability and compliance into Volcano's architecture - not bolt it on later.

- Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies: Given Volcano's greenfield nature, evaluate and make architectural decisions on edge runtimes, serverless compute, vector databases, and AI-native infrastructure components.

 

What You'll Bring:

- BS in Computer Science or equivalent; substantial experience at Staff or Principal IC level in SRE/Platform Engineering.

- Proven track record building SRE or platform engineering practices for developer-facing platforms or PaaS/SaaS products - ideally at greenfield stage.

- Kubernetes expertise: multi-tenant cluster design, networking (CNI, service mesh, ingress), autoscaling, and security hardening.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. - People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

- Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

- Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

- Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

- Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable - without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones .

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions-or turning a transcript into copy. ABOUT THE ROLE

Kong is hiring an ADR Team Lead to support our NEMEA region: the UK, Benelux, and Nordics. This is a player-coach role. You'll carry your own pipeline targets while taking an active hand in developing the team around you, especially the newer ADRs still finding their footing.

You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves.

Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast.

You'll report to Oscar Winberg. He moves fast, sets a high bar, and expects people to bring solutions, not just flag problems. He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Carry your own number. You'll hit your own pipeline targets as an active ADR. Your activity and results set the standard for everyone watching. You'll contribute to weekly forecasting alongside the Senior Manager.

Support newer ADRs. You'll be the first point of contact for less tenured reps, helping them ramp faster and build good habits early. You'll help with onboarding alongside the Senior Manager and Enablement, and run regular 1:1s with newer ADRs. Different reps need different things from you, so you'll read where each person is and adjust your coaching accordingly rather than running the same playbook on everyone. At Motorola Solutions , we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Motorola Solutions is looking for an experienced Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Ecosystem & Technology lead go-to-market strategy across our Public Safety, Defense, and Enterprise portfolios. This is a high-visibility, highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership-orchestrating priority cross-sector initiatives and storytelling to drive growth.

This person will set vision and execute against it - a true player/coach who can zoom out to shape strategy and zoom in to build the collateral, integrated campaign or launch plan themselves.

Who You Are

• You are a strategic thinker who can also roll up your sleeves - comfortable setting a vision and then personally executing against it

• You are a creative storyteller with excellent communication skills that span writing, speaking, and presenting

• You thrive leading highly cross-functional initiatives, building trust and alignment across teams inside and outside of Marketing.

• You are curious and adaptable - open to learning new technologies, audiences, and markets, and comfortable creatively problem-solving as priorities and information shifts

• You can take complex products, programs, or organizational changes and distill them into clear, concise, value-focused messages and plans

• You are organized, with excellent follow-through, and can own high-priority projects end-to-end - from strategy to activation

• You can admit mistakes, learn from them, and move forward

What You'll D o

Technology Partner Marketing

• Define and own the technology partnership marketing strategy - including which alliances and ecosystem partners to prioritize - and build the playbook and governance model that scales partnership marketing across sectors

• Lead messaging, enablement, and campaigns that bring partner and ecosystem value to life for customers and partners

Ecosystem Product Marketing

• Lead ecosystem product marketing go-to-market strategy across three core sectors: Public Safety, Video, and Defense.

• Craft messaging and positioning that demonstrates the value of integrated solution and AI-driven capabilities across core personas and verticals

• Be the voice of target audience definition, pain points, and white space opportunities

• Develop sales enablement and integrated campaigns to drive awareness, adoption, and pipeline

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related technical field

• 7+ years of experience in Product Marketing or B2B technology marketing

• Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives beyond core marketing

• Experience with partner or developer ecosystem marketing a plus

• Experience working with hardware/software or cloud (SaaS) solutions a plus, with an emphasis on public safety, security, or defense technology

• Strong communication skills paired with a data-driven, consultative approach to complex B2B solution strategy

• Demonstrated ability to both set strategic direction and execute hands-on - comfortable operating as an individual contributor with outsized scope and visibility

.

See yourself at Twilio

As Sr. Manager of GTM Finance for Global Partnerships, you will serve as the primary strategic co-pilot to the VP of Global Partnerships. You will design economic models driving our ecosystem strategy across Cloud Marketplaces (AWS, GCP, Azure), Global Systems Integrators (GSIs), and ISVs-ensuring partner incentive investments accelerate usage-based revenue while achieving profitability goals.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:

• Serve as the primary, trusted financial and strategic advisor to the VP of Global Partnerships and his global leadership team

title: Cognitive Care Neurologist (Telehealth)
description:
About Synapticure
As a patient and caregiver-founded company, Synapticure provides instant access to expert neurologists, cutting-edge treatments and trials, and wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support in all 50 states through a virtual care platform. Partnering with providers and health plans, including CMS' new GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and ALS.

Synapticure ’s Cognitive Care team delivers personalized, comprehensive care to patients and caregivers navigating memory and cognitive disorders, from early-stage mild cognitive impairment to advanced dementias. Our clinicians combine evidence-based medicine with technology-enabled care coordination to simplify access and ensure patients receive expert, compassionate support wherever they live.
The Role

Synapticure is seeking a Telehealth Cognitive Care Neurologist to provide expert clinical care for patients living with Alzheimer’s disease, dementia, and related cognitive disorders. In this role, you will conduct comprehensive virtual evaluations, diagnose and manage complex neurodegenerative conditions, and collaborate closely with interdisciplinary team members-including advanced practice providers (APPs), behavioral health specialists, and care coordinators-to ensure a seamless and supportive patient experience.
As a Cognitive Neurologist, you will play a critical leadership role in both direct patient care and clinical oversight, supervising APPs across multiple states and ensuring adherence to clinical standards and telehealth regulations. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cognitive neurology including memory disorders, thrives in a virtual care environment, and is passionate about expanding access to specialized neurological care for patients and families across the country.
The Day to Day

• Conduct virtual consultations, cognitive assessments, and diagnostic evaluations for patients with Alzheimer’s disease, dementia, mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and related conditions

• Supervise and collaborate with Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) across multiple states, providing clinical guidance and ensuring adherence to practice standards and state regulatory requirements

• Develop individualized, evidence-based care plans that incorporate pharmacologic management, cognitive therapy recommendations, and supportive care strategies

• Oversee the prescription of medications, ordering of diagnostic tests, and interpretation of results as part of comprehensive patient care

• Collaborate with behavioral health clinicians, care coordinators, and other interdisciplinary team members to optimize care continuity and quality outcomes

• Participate in case conferences and team meetings to review complex cases and contribute to clinical decision-making

• Stay current with emerging therapies, including anti-amyloid and disease-modifying treatments for dementia, and support patient education regarding these options

• Support caregiver engagement and education, helping families understand disease progression, treatment plans, and available resources

• Document all encounters accurately and promptly in the electronic health record (EHR), ensuring compliance with telehealth and regulatory standards

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Synapticure ’s cognitive care protocols, leveraging technology to streamline care delivery and enhance patient experience
Research, Innovation, and Clinical Trials

At Synapticure , we believe that advancing dementia care requires not only excellence in clinical practice but also active participation in research and innovation. As part of our Cognitive Care program, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with leading research organizations and industry partners to bring cutting-edge therapies to patients through clinical trials and real-world ev

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Malaga, Spain
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Data Architect Senior
description:
Data Architect Senior
We are seeking a Data Architect Senior to support a public sector environmental regulatory modernization initiative. This role will design and lead data integration between a regulatory system, a Databricks-based data management platform, and a geospatial platform. The focus is establishing trusted, timely, and reusable data for regulators, decision-makers, and the public. The ideal candidate will set the direction for how regulatory, environmental, and spatial data moves, connects, and is governed across these systems, working within a high-performing, multidisciplinary team in a fast-paced, agile environment.
This position requires someone who can design enterprise data architectures and lead complex system integrations to support a regulatory program. The role encompasses defining target-state data architecture across multiple platforms, designing conceptual, logical, and physical data models for regulatory and geospatial domains, and establishing integration patterns suited to each use case. Responsibilities include architecting lakehouse structures on Databricks with medallion layers and Delta Lake tables, designing spatial data flows that preserve geometry and coordinate reference systems, leading data pipeline design with data engineers and developers, defining data contracts and API specifications, resolving complex integration issues, embedding data governance practices including metadata management and lineage, ensuring compliance with government information security and privacy standards, defining data quality rules and monitoring approaches, applying role-based access controls, serving as a trusted advisor to program leadership and technical teams, coordinating with enterprise architecture and cybersecurity teams, producing architecture documentation and decision records, and mentoring team members on data architecture best practices. • Retrospective/prospective biological sample procurement

title: Founding Robot Operator, US
description:
Everyone should be able to afford a well-built home in a beautiful neighborhood. Our ambition is to help solve the housing crisis and bring beauty back to the places we live. We are developing robots that can make intricate, high-quality construction affordable at scale. We are hiring our founding Robot Operators in the United States, starting with our first pilot in San Antonio, Texas.

You will help bring a system already used on sites in the Netherlands and the UK to a new market. As one of our first US operators, you will help establish how we work on site and give our engineering team direct feedback from the field.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is hands-on construction work with robots. You will move bricks and mortar, keep the robots supplied, set up equipment and clean the site. You will also operate the robots using Atrium, our in-house software, and work with our engineers when something needs fixing.

No previous robotics or construction experience is required. We are looking for practical people with technical intuition, an eye for detail and the initiative to solve problems. We will train you to operate our systems. This is a full-time role. Training starts at our headquarters in Amsterdam, with costs covered by Monumental.

Our operators come from construction, retail, hospitality, events, farms, workshops and engineering. What they share is a preference for working with their hands and seeing the things they build.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Prepare construction projects: understand the build plan and assess site conditions.

- Place markers and take photos for 3D reconstruction.

- Set up and operate masonry robots using a laptop and our software.

- Carry and load bricks and mortar, move equipment and keep the work area safe and tidy.

- Help with site tasks such as cutting bricks, setting wall ties and pointing walls.

- Troubleshoot with our engineering and operations teams.

- Record problems and improvements so our engineers can develop the hardware and software.

- Work with the contractors and trades around you as the face of Monumental on site.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- A practical, technical mindset and a willingness to learn.

- Comfort with physical work outdoors, early starts and changing site conditions.

- Attention to detail: the quality of the finished wall matters.

- Initiative when something does not go to plan.

- A valid driver’s license and comfort driving to construction sites.

- Good spoken and written English for working with our team.

- Construction, maintenance or other hands-on experience is useful, but not required.

LOCATION

This is an on-site role in San Antonio, Texas, starting with our first US pilot. You need to be able to work on construction sites in the San Antonio area. This is not a remote role.

WHY MONUMENTAL?

You will be part of the team bringing our robots to US construction sites for the first time. The work combines physical building, technical problem-solving and direct collaboration with the people developing the robots. Your feedback will help shape the next deployment.

Learn more about Monumental https://www.monumental.co/about, Atrium https://www.monumental.co/atrium and life as a Robot Operator https://www.monumental.co/blog/the-best-product-job-isnt-in-engineering.

If you do not meet every line above but enjoy building things and solving practical problems, we would still like to hear from you.

title: Structural Dynamics Engineer
description: The Destinus engineering team is seeking an Aeroelastic/Structural Dynamics Engineer to lead structural dynamic and aeroelastic simulation activities across our vehicle programmes, from model setup through test correlation. The ideal candidate bridges analysis and test - ensuring dynamic behaviour is accurately predicted, verified, and substantiated against experimental data. What You’ll Do · Set up, execute, and post-process structural dynamics and aeroelastic simulations · Create and maintain Global Finite Element Models (GFEM) representing vehicle-level dynamic behaviour, ensuring consistency and traceability with detailed local FE models · Support structural dynamic qualification and verification of components, subsystems, and full vehicle assemblies · Define, document, and oversee execution of vibration, modal survey, and ground vibration test (GVT) campaigns · Correlate simulation predictions against experimental test data; interpret and communicate results clearly · Prepare technical reports, analysis documentation, and design justification packages Requirements What You’ll Need · Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field · 3-5 years of industry experience in structural dynamics, aeroelasticity, or vibration engineering · Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct - for modal, transient, frequency response, and/or random vibration analysis · Demonstrated experience defining and executing vibration and dynamic test plans · Strong ability to correlate experimental test data against simulation predictions · Solid grounding in structural dynamics fundamentals: SDOF/MDOF systems, modal analysis, damping, and forced response Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
